memory.duration_each: Memory loss is gradual, not episodic, so episode length, side and trigger do not apply; sudden onset and stroke signs are covered by speed_of_onset and the danger screen.
memory.one_sided: Memory loss is gradual, not episodic, so episode length, side and trigger do not apply; sudden onset and stroke signs are covered by speed_of_onset and the danger screen.
memory.trigger: Memory loss is gradual, not episodic, so episode length, side and trigger do not apply; sudden onset and stroke signs are covered by speed_of_onset and the danger screen.

tremor.consciousness: Tremor does not alter awareness; loss of consciousness is asked under fainted and fits.

sunburn.contacts: Not a contagious or shared-exposure problem; contacts are asked only for rashes that can spread between people.

mole.fever: Fever is not a feature of a changing mole or of hair loss; systemic illness is screened elsewhere if the person reports it.

head_injury.weight_bearing: Head injury; standing and walking are assessed under fall and trouble_walking, and imbalance under the neuro danger screen.

cut.consciousness: Limb or skin injury with no head strike, electrical shock or smoke exposure; loss of consciousness is screened by the head_injury problem and the danger screen.
cut.weight_bearing: Wound, burn or sting of skin does not by itself limit standing or walking; limb function is captured under broken_bone and sprain.
cut.deformity: Soft-tissue injury; bone deformity and open fracture are screened by broken_bone (looksBent, boneThrough).

burn.anticoagulant: Bleeding tendency matters for cuts, bruises and head injury; not a factor in the clinical course of a burn, sting or sprain.
